description: This file defines the EAPMViewEdit class, which extends the ViewEdit class in a SuiteCRM module. It contains methods for handling user-specific editing views, including setting return IDs, generating module title parameters, and rendering the edit view with access control. The class manages user redirections, display configurations, and incorporates internationalization and permission checks.
